content: The vaccine is supplied with 7 mL of saline diluent. The tip caps of the needleless prefilled syringes may contain natural rubber latex. The lyophilized vaccine is provided under the following National Drug Codes (NDCs): NDC 58160-806-01: Vial of lyophilized vaccine in a package of 10. NDC 58160-806-05: Syringe containing diluent in a package of 10. NDC 58160-951-02 and NDC 58160-951-11: Syringe containing diluent in a package of 10. Storage Instructions Before Reconstitution: Lyophilized vaccine vials should be stored refrigerated at a temperature between 2°C and 8°C (36°F and 46°F). Protect the vials from light. The diluent can be stored refrigerated at 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F) or at controlled room temperature between 20°C and 25°C (68°F to 77°F). Do not freeze the diluent. If the diluent has been frozen, it must be discarded. Storage Instructions After Reconstitution: The reconstituted vaccine (Hiberix) must be administered within 24 hours of reconstitution. After reconstitution, the vaccine should be stored refrigerated at a temperature between 2°C and 8°C (36°F and 46°F). If the reconstituted vaccine is not used within 24 hours, it must be discarded. Do not freeze the reconstituted vaccine. If the vaccine has been frozen, it must be discarded.
